title: Automate changelog and onboard elysia-13b v1.1 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Priya Gupta
description: Motivation: Add elysia-13b v1.1 to the model registry with curated performance profiles and automate changelog/release-note generation for future onboards. This PR bundles: 1) metadata for elysia-13b v1.1 (model size, tokenizer, license, compat matrix), 2) validated perf profiles for common GPU configs (4xA100, 8xA10, 1xT4 batch-friendly profiles), 3) test harness updates to surface perf regressions, and 4) a small automation hook that generates changelog entries from perf/metadata diffs and appends them to the release_notes registry. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata YAML and canonical model slug - [x] Add perf profiles (latency/throughput/SLO guidance) - [x] Add quickstart example snippet to docs - [x] CI tests pass (unit + perf smoke) - [x] Automate changelog generation (script + workflow) - [x] Update model-registry index. Notes: Perf profiles were produced from the benchmark-lab harness using the standard sequence-length distribution we use for 13B onboards. Observed median p50 latencies and tokens/sec are recorded in the perf_profiles files. Changelog automation: generate_changelog.py looks for new model directories or profile diffs and creates one-line release notes including model slug, version, summary of perf deltas vs baseline, and a link to the benchmark artifact. This is intentionally conservative (no automatic publish) — the script only generates entries and creates a draft changelog PR when run by CI. See related Linear ENG-7421 for rollout plan and PM-183 for doc updates.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial metadata + perf profiles; tuning A100 profile; add changelog generation script + tests; add CI workflow entry; documentation and examples update.
